<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Book of Warding Prayers](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2172)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Grimoire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=387" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 111 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 425 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Script in a language of the Outer Planes adorns this book's spine, and a deity's symbol is etched on its cover. _Books of warding prayers_ are each devoted to a particular deity and are also a [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of that deity.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** Your last action was to cast a prepared divine spell granted by your deity;  **Effect** Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful; you can't choose a type that's part of your deity's alignment. You and all allies within 30 feet are suffused with your deity's protection, gaining resistance 10 to damage of that type for 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
